statistics.sample_count: not reported; do not infer full31*96observations from month mention

effect_arithmetic.units: MAE/RMSEkW and MAPE percentage points; printed differences agree
effect_arithmetic.daily_error_note: 103.18*24=2476.32;61.40*24=1473.6;37.01*24=888.24, close to reported2476.4/1473.5/888.2kWh. This is compatible with integrating absolute error, not independent evidence of signed total daily energy bias.

statistics.threshold_claim: Generic Chinese3% error standard has no identified standard/metric reference here; not adopted as a normative threshold
statistics.convergence: Empirical fitness trace only; no probability guarantee or runtime improvement proven
statistics.generalization: One region/month, no unseen season/site, real dispatch or renewable integration benefit experiment

narrative.abstract: Problem -> baseline choice -> HHO -> several enhancements -> generic three-metric gain; no numeric effect or split
narrative.pattern: Each result section motivates the next stronger optimizer; progressive narrative is clear but selection and confirmation data not separated
narrative.conclusion: Three numbered claims mirror BiLSTM, HHO and DE-IHHO stages; no explicit limitations
narrative.term_warning: contrastive/adversarial/dyadic names refer to OBL here, not automatically contrastive representation learning

critical_links: 34 equations are mostly inherited mechanisms; quantity does not measure novel theory
Modified optimizer changes multiple factors together, so curve improvement cannot identify each mechanism
Same nominal search iterations can involve different fitness counts and training costs
Smoothing controls require dimensional meaning before application across epoch count, neurons and learning rate
Forecasting error improvement does not establish a dispatch or demand-response benefit
